## Summary

Describe the user-visible or engineering change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant automated tests pass.
- [ ] Version mirrors are synchronized when `version.json` changed.
- [ ] Marketplace artifacts are regenerated when plugin source changed.
- [ ] Compatibility, migration, security, and rollback impacts are documented when applicable.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated for user-facing changes.

## Promotion

- [ ] Target is `alpha`, or this is an approved `alpha` to `main` release PR / `hotfix/*` to `main` PR.
